== Summary ==
Identified: none. Back view of a player in a grey hoodie covered in player stickers and rust-colored pants, seated at a wooden table in front of the 2022 flag board at Bromborough Bowl. The wearer's face is not visible. An opponent's arm in a dark sleeve is at right. Faces unlabeled.
A player at the 2022 Naboo Regionals (Bromborough Bowl, 23 July 2022) wearing a hoodie covered in player stickers, in front of the event's 2022 flag board. Team Wales posted it a week after the event as the "Sticker program in Europe".

* '''Event:''' [[2022 Regional Championships]] (Naboo Regionals)
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-07-30
* '''Identification:''' the wearer is not named in the post.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1384044#p1384044 Advertising space for rent], post 1384044, by Darth Eweuge, 2022-07-30. Original attachment name: Sticker program in Europe.PNG (1170×2532); forum attachment id 17247.
* '''Posted by:''' Darth Eweuge
Cropped to the photograph: the black bars of the phone screenshot are removed.
